# Citekind

> Citekind is an AI search visibility (answer engine optimisation) consultancy for B2B cybersecurity and fintech scale-ups in the UK and Europe. It helps companies improve how often they are found, cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Google AI Overviews. It is led by a former cybersecurity CMO.

## Services

- [AI Visibility Audit](https://citekind.com/#audit): a fixed-price audit that tests 30 to 50 real buyer questions across the major AI assistants, measures share of answer against competitors and delivers a prioritised 90-day plan.
- [Services](https://citekind.com/#services): answer-ready content programmes with a monthly visibility scorecard, and fractional CMO support for cybersecurity and fintech scale-ups.
- [Free AI visibility check](https://citekind.com/check/): an instant AI readiness score for any website plus a guided self-test of what AI assistants say.
